items.headline: TCU beats Kansas State 20-10 after Wildcats' flight lands about 3 hours before kickoff
items.description: — Jaden Craig threw a touchdown, Kari Ashley ran for a score, and TCU beat Kansas State 20-10 on Saturday, a game that kicked off only about three hours after the Wildcats' team flight landed in Texas.
